definitions.explanation: To move something back and forth.

notes:
{振|ふ}る is a godan verb meaning to wave, shake, or sprinkle.

CONJUGATION:
{振|ふ}らない (neg), {振|ふ}ります (polite), {振|ふ}って (te-form), {振|ふ}った (past)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {手|て}を{振|ふ}る: to wave (one's hand)
- {首|くび}を{振|ふ}る: to shake one's head (disagreement)
- {尻尾|しっぽ}を{振|ふ}る: to wag one's tail
- {塩|しお}を{振|ふ}る: to sprinkle salt
- サイコロを{振|ふ}る: to roll dice
- {振|ふ}り{向|む}く: to turn around

DON'T CONFUSE:
- {振|ふ}る: to wave, shake (transitive)
- {降|ふ}る: to fall (rain/snow) (intransitive)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {振動|しんどう}: vibration
- {振替|ふりかえ}: transfer, exchange
